cover.alt: A model stands atop a vivid cobalt blue-painted boulder in an arid desert landscape — dry scrub brush, rolling ochre mountains, and wide blue sky. She wears a bold red lace midi dress layered with billowing red tulle, orange heeled sandals, and a voluminous red-toned afro. Behind her, a large circular disc in yellow-green gradient forms a sun-like halo. The composition is strikingly primary — red, blue, yellow — against the natural desert palette.
